title: the extraction grammars are counted in comments, and the copies already disagree: six, seven, and two that print unanchored, against a list of eight
body:
Found by cc on 2026-10-24 while building 0208, and filed by dc on vc's assignment, which hv approved. 0208 covers docs and help pages only, so a count of the extraction grammars written into comments was outside its scope. hv's rule in the user-scope AGENTS.md: "No number of checks, tests, liberators or anything else goes into a doc, a guard, a test or a constant in code ... A count already written down is deleted, never corrected."

**The class:** the run-log extraction grammars are a set the tree grows. `grammar_names` in lib/runlog lists them: mix, credo, cargo, xcodebuild, lua, shell, critic and generic. The comments state the set's size, or the size of the subset that prints on unanchored patterns, and the copies no longer agree with each other or with the list. Lines by main 19d15680:

- tests/unit/updatenotice.bats:114 -- "a run log that six extraction grammars parse".
- lib/runlog:57 -- "Two of the six grammars print on UNANCHORED patterns".
- lib/runlog:454 -- "two grammars print on unanchored patterns".
- lib/runlog:494 -- "All seven were byte-identical in every project that carried them" (the next sentence names shell and generic as new, so "seven" cannot be the corpus's set).
- lib/runlog:1149 -- "two grammars match on unanchored patterns".
- lib/helpers:4410 and :4411 -- "seven extraction grammars parse it; two print on unanchored patterns".
- tests/unit/runlog.bats:893 -- "two of them print on UNANCHORED patterns".

**Fix:** delete each number. Say what the grammars are, not how many, and name the unanchored ones (credo's and xcodebuild's) where the reason needs them, so no copy can disagree again. Comments only, so there is no behaviour change and no new test. The rest of the tree's written counts, found by the same read, are filed apart for after the 0.1.14 cut.


## Resolution

Fixed at 9367a65e, on landing suite 20261024-1756 at 62c632b4 (2474 of 2474 ok, 5 environmental skips, the errors seal empty), with the fleet-less candidate suite 20261024-1805 from the same tip green. dc built it, and vc landed it.

> **0219 (2026-10-24, by dc on vc's assignment with hv's approval):** the extraction grammars were counted in comments, in copies that disagreed with each other and with `grammar_names` ("six", "seven", and "two" unanchored, against a list of eight). Every count is deleted, not corrected: `tests/unit/updatenotice.bats`, `lib/runlog` (four comments), `lib/helpers` (the update notice's stderr note) and `tests/unit/runlog.bats` now say what the grammars are, or "some", never how many; `lib/runlog` still names credo's and xcodebuild's as the unanchored ones. Comments only: `shfmt -mn` is the same for all four files and no test title changed. Commit 9367a65e (built as dfcb603c). The suites named for it (updatenotice, runlog, the six tree scans and help) are green under BSD and GNU.
>
> **Found, not fixed:** the tree's other written counts in comments and test titles, and the positional names found beside them ("step 6", "the first two"), are issue 0220, built after the 0.1.14 cut on vc's word.
